case_status.current_case_status_text_en: Card Was Personally Delivered To Me
case_status.current_case_status_desc_en: On September 5, 2023, we personally delivered your card for Receipt Number EAC9999103409, to you. If you move, go to www.uscis.gov/addresschange to give us your new mailing address.
